title: Towards Intersectionality in Machine Learning: Including More Identities, Handling Underrepresentation, and Performing Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The study focuses on intersectional fairness across demographic attributes such as race, sex, marital status, and disability.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
